messages:
marie: Quick sync — follow-up from the modularization RFC. We tried the 'strata' sequencing in the last sprint. Bottom line: we hit the expected isolation, but coupling still shows up in the enrichment path.

sam: Agree. The enrichment service still calls the old session-mesh for auth metadata. We patched with a shim; cost was ok but adds temporary latency.

jon: Can you paste the shim? I'd like to evaluate removing it next sprint.

marie: pasted below
```
# temporary shim in enrichment
if req.source == 'legacy':
  token = legacy_client.fetch_meta(req.sid)
else:
  token = auth_proxy.get(req.sid)
```

lina: That shim is fine short-term but it keeps the old mesh live. My proposal: schedule a 2-week carveout where auth-proxy implements legacy fetch API and we toggle traffic in canary.

sam: +1. Also recommend adding a gating healthcheck: /compat/legacy_meta returning 200 only when proxies synced.

jon: We measured impact: p50 latency +12ms, p95 +38ms under 500rps. Not huge but accumulates. Also saw 3 regressions in the helm chart; sharing logs.

devops-bot: deploy 2026-03-18T14:03Z to staging completed :white_check_mark:

marie: Next actions: (1) Lina - draft the 2-week carveout plan and the toggle runbook; (2) Sam - add /compat healthcheck and metric; (3) Jon - remove shim after canary; (4) I'll own postmortem if rollback needed. Target start: 2026-03-25. Any objections?

lina: No objections. I'll ping infra for quota.

sam: I'll add the healthcheck PR today and link the dashboard.

jon: I'll prep the canary config and a rollback playbook.

marie: Cool — small note on tech-debt paydown: let's add a T-shirt size estimate to each task (S / M / L) so PMs can prioritize. Add them in comments on the PRs.

lina: Will do. S for the healthcheck, M for the compat API, L for the full mesh shutdown.

sam: tagging @kevin (security) — we should confirm there are no policy implications for the compat endpoint.

marie: good call. I'll loop Kevin in a separate thread. Thanks all.
